data.one_liner: Produce a report summarizing the health and quality of a Dart package
data.what_it_does: A library for analyzing Dart packages that invokes executables from the Dart SDK or Flutter SDK. It generates reports covering documentation, static analysis, dependencies, and Dart conventions.
use_when: You want to analyze the health and quality of a Dart package locally
You are building tools that require package metrics and scoring reports
avoid_when: You need a general-purpose runtime package manager rather than an analysis tool
strengths: Used directly by the official Dart Package site (pub.dev)
Supports local directories or hosted packages from pub.dev
Comprehensive health reporting across multiple categories
weaknesses: Requires access to the Dart SDK or Flutter SDK environments
data.setup_notes: Can be activated globally via pub using `dart pub global activate pana`.
data.minimal_example:
dart pub global activate pana
pana --hosted <published package name>
